decisions.reason: The modular plant concept is only mentioned, not given its own page, so its results are uncertain, but it fits the firm's modular strategy and the firm's R&D slack lets it carry the concept a while longer.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has kept its own page for two years, which suggests results near aspiration and gives no reason for problemistic search.
As a multi-model flagship line central to the firm's direction, it carries strong organisational commitment, so management will tolerate uncertain early results rather than drop it.
The recently launched multi-model shredder line is core business with its own page, and it is too early for any shortfall against aspiration to trigger removal.
The new spiral shaft screen line extends the established offer, possibly replacing the dropped trommel screen, and its own page signals continued investment.
